title: Dispatch: Elemental Gem type variants + exact castSpell readiness via owned grant (attempt 1, Luna)
description:
Implementation dispatch for eshyra-xt6m.1 (Codex gpt-6-luna). Worktree .worktrees/eshyra-xt6m.1.1, branch eshyra-xt6m.1.1, cut from the eshyra-xt6m.1 parent branch, which already contains the eshyra-olc5.16 Bag of Tricks work (color variants, `creatureRoll`, migration 0051). Read `bd show eshyra-xt6m.1` (owning spec + 2026-10-18 user decision + 2026-10-26 note), AGENTS.md, docs/importer-fix-protocol.md, docs/rules-pack-compiler.md, before editing. Study the Horn of Valhalla variant work (git show b0dd7111) and the Bag of Tricks work on this branch; copy their idioms.

SOURCE (SRD 5.1 p. 220): "When you use an action to break the gem, an elemental is summoned as if you had cast the conjure elemental spell, and the gem's magic is lost. The type of gem determines the elemental summoned by the spell." table:elemental-gem: Blue sapphire -> Air elemental; Yellow diamond -> Earth; Red corundum -> Fire; Emerald -> Water.

DECISIONS (made by the supervisor under the user's 2026-10-18 decision; implement, do not redesign):
G1 Gem type = magic-item VARIANT (persistent per instance; a stack row has one type). parseMagicItems.ts: extractElementalGemVariants beside the Horn/Bag extractors: variants Blue Sapphire, Yellow Diamond, Red Corundum, Emerald (canonical ids blue-sapphire, yellow-diamond, red-corundum, emerald), rarity matching the record's ('uncommon', same casing convention the Horn/Bag variants use), text 'Summoned elemental: Air elemental.' etc. Abort if the description loses 'The type of gem determines the elemental summoned by the spell.' Add assertElementalGemTypesMatchTable called from emit.ts under compileExecutableSemantics (columns Gem|Summoned Elemental, the 4 rows pinned).
G2 Grants (magicItemEntityGrants.ts, 'Elemental Gem' SPEC ~line 295): replace gem-elemental with four grants `<variant-id>-elemental` (e.g. blue-sapphire-elemental), each variants [id], creatureRefs [the one elemental], tableRefs ['table:elemental-gem'], count 1, duration 1 hour, revertOn ['reduced-to-0-hit-points','one-hour-ended'], cooldownEconomy 'quantity', control 'as spell:conjure-elemental'. The m4 grant then satisfies creatureGrantLifecycleOwned (one creature per grant) and goes green; its control span clause (CONTROL span list line ~84) is emitted as for the vessels. Update the ownership doc comment that says the Gem stays pending until eshyra-xt6m.1, and magicItemGrantOwnership.test.ts owned/kept sets.
G3 m1-quantity: remove the `{F4, 'spell execution and summoned entity ownership'}` engineHooks from the Elemental Gem spec in magicItemConsumables.ts (~line 241). Rationale to record in the thaw note: under the user decision the engine owes NO spell execution (no deterministic spell procedure is selected; the DM adjudicates residual spell semantics), and summoned-entity ownership is the m4 grant's responsibility, owned per clause. The quantity economy itself (spend one from the stack, gem destroyed) is executed by use_item, as for the 9 green M1 consumables.
G4 The castSpell effect 'summon-elemental' needs an EXACT trusted readiness clause (assertMagicItemOperationReady in src/state/itemExecutionReadiness.ts refuses an operation effect with no `{block:'effects', effectId}` clause). Add an extraClause to the Gem consumable spec: id 'm1-effect-summon-elemental', tag 'M1', representation {block:'effects', effectId:'summon-elemental'}, engineHooks [{engine:'F4', hook:'castSpell effect realized by an owned creature grant'}]. Then in magicItemCompiler.ts (the per-clause ownership code around line 950, beside activationOwned/grantOwned) add a per-clause owner `castSpellRealizedByOwnedGrant` (put the predicate in magicItemGrantOwnership.ts, documented like creatureGrantLifecycleOwned) that removes exactly that hook when ALL hold for the clause's scope: the effect is kind 'castSpell' with a spellRef; every operation listing the effect spends an economy; the effective entityGrant is owned (creatureGrantLifecycleOwned) and every creature grant naming that economy as cooldownEconomy has control === `as spell:${spellRef}`, a duration deep-equal to the effect's duration, and (effect.concentrationRequired === true, which the binder enforces for an 'as spell:' control). Otherwise the hook stays and the clause is engine-pending. It must NOT apply to Staff of the Magi c2-cast-conjure-elemental or any other castSpell effect (they have no such grant and different hooks) — add a counterfactual test that a castSpell effect without a matching grant, with a duration mismatch, or with a different spellRef stays pending. The clause claims only what the engine does: identity, concentration, 1-hour and 0-HP endings via start_effect; nothing else of the spell. Do NOT add a new hook to LANDED_MAGIC_ITEM_ENGINE_HOOKS.
G5 Residual adjudication (AC5): the existing hook-free adjudicated triage-entityGrant clause already carries verbatim "When you use an action to break the gem, an elemental is summoned as if you had cast the conjure elemental spell, and the gem's magic is lost." Keep it. The one-action casting-time override is the typed operation activation cost 'action' — keep it, and add to the use_item description (toolUseItem.ts) one clause: an item that casts or summons 'as if you had cast' a spell uses the item's printed activation (e.g. the Elemental Gem's action), not the spell's casting time. Do not duplicate sentences into new clauses.
G6 Feather Token: NO change (AC4 truthful outcome: use-token stays refused, its hooks are named by the existing refusal; the bird stays pending on DM-ended endings; payloads DM). Record this in your report and the thaw note.
G7 give_item description (toolGiveItem.ts): an Elemental Gem is given with its gem type as variantId (blue-sapphire, yellow-diamond, red-corundum, emerald); a stack holds one type.
G8 Regenerate the canonical pack: `npm run import:dnd5e-srd -- --out packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/` (the default --out is scratch!), `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack`; regenerate the semi-structured inventory via writeCommittedOutputs() from packages/core/scripts/inventory-semi-structured-boundary.ts using a throwaway tsx script outside the repo tree; thaw note docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/thaw-notes/2026-10-31-eshyra-xt6m-1-1-elemental-gem-type-and-readiness.md in the format of the other thaw notes (exact before->after counts, newly ready operations). Update srdGeneratedPack.test.ts count pins to the ACTUAL regenerated values, add break-gem to the READY list in magicItemOperationSourceAgreement.test.ts and the Gem to CONFORMANCE_BACKED in itemGrantRealPackReadiness.test.ts if they have such entries. Never weaken any other pin.

EVIDENCE (real pack, unmodified, NO readiness waiver; see itemGrantRealPackReadiness.test.ts / itemGrantConsumptionReceipt tests for the receipt path):
 X1 give_item an emerald Elemental Gem (quantity 1); use_item break-gem succeeds on the real pack (proves G3+G4 readiness), stack consumed, consumption receipt written with variant emerald; start_effect binds a creature:water-elemental combatant (campaignActorId, concentrationOwner) to emerald-elemental -> succeeds with 1-hour timer and concentration.
 X2 refusals: a creature:fire-elemental on emerald-elemental; binding red-corundum-elemental from an emerald receipt (variant refusal); bind without concentration; a second bind of the same receipt; a bind with no use_item (no receipt).
 X3 compiler: counterfactuals from G4; ownership test updates from G2.
 Negative-proof each new binder/compiler assertion once and list them in your report.

FORBIDDEN: a readiness waiver in production code; a modified-pack test as proof; a generic castSpell executor; touching Feather Token semantics; weakening any test.

PROCESS: implement; from the worktree root run `npm run verify:worktree` (rewrites files) and only commit if it exits 0; commit on eshyra-xt6m.1.1 (message starts 'eshyra-xt6m.1.1'); report via `bd update eshyra-xt6m.1.1 --append-notes "..."` (files, decisions, exact count deltas, newly ready operations, negative proofs, verify result); file follow-ups with bd create; `bd close eshyra-xt6m.1.1`.
